title: Custom Stand Name Changer
features:
Tutorial:
1. Claim A Stand
2. Run It
3. Enjoy
script:
local replicated_storage = cloneref(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"))

getgenv().settings = {
	enabled = true,
	rainbow_text = true,
	text = "Put Your Text Here It Can Be Anything!",
	font = "SourceSansItalic", -- https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/enums/Font
	color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) -- This will only work if rainbow text is false
}

if settings.enabled then
	repeat
		if settings.rainbow_text then
			local t = 5
			local hue = tick() % t / t
			local colorr = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
			replicated_storage:WaitForChild("RemoteEvent"):FireServer("poner", { settings.text, settings.font, colorr })
		else
			replicated_storage:WaitForChild("RemoteEvent"):FireServer("poner", { settings.text, settings.font, settings.color })
		end
		task.wait()
	until not settings.enabled
end
